newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's O/N rates surge to close at 26.50 pc.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's O/N rates surge to close at 26.50 pc.

text.p: Hungarian overnight rates surged some eight percent during the year's first day of trade in tight money supply, traders sad on Thursday.
"At the beginning of the week, when rates were low, many market players had put their money in the (central bank's) one-week and even one-month repo facility," said Lajos Molnar of OTP Bank.
Overnight rates closed on Thursday at 26.50 percent compared with Tuesday's close of 18 percent and were expected to remain this high until Monday or Tuesday.
